answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake that unlocks only after a long history of useful, attested work, so spawning thousands of fake identities becomes prohibitively expensive. New identities start with no trust and must earn it through consistent, verifiable service, while peers can slash the stake of any identity caught cheating. A lone fake may drift by like a comet over a tundra dune, but a Sybil swarm leaves a visible trail of shared funding and identical timing that the network can reject together.
